title: Asymptotic e-processes
summary: We investigate the concept of an asymptotic e-process, which is a doubly-indexed stochastic process $(E_{m,n})_{m,n\in\mathbb{N}}$ that possesses, asymptotically for an approximation index $m\to\infty$, the properties of an e-process along a monitoring time index $n$. This constitutes the first in-depth study of this recently introduced concept, which is relevant in asymptotic sequential anytime-valid inference.
